entities.summary: Nadia Evadne Cattouse was a British actress and singer. She began her onscreen acting career in 1954 and was best known for her roles in many British television programmes, including Angels, Play for Today, Crown Court, Within These Walls, Dixon of Dock Green and Johnny Jarvis.
